title: The final one of our online arcade shoot-out trifecta is ready for demo.
author: the_badget
selftext:
Bannerfall is finally out. It's the third and the last one of the 3-game portal Fourfold we've built. All three share the same overall gameplay, but each adds a little tweak. Bannerfall adds a bit of strategy - you compete against 3 other players to capture resources and then use them to beat the boss. For honor!  
Try it here [https://www.playtest.win/games/fourfold](https://www.playtest.win/games/fourfold) (you don't have to register if you don't want to leave reviews).

P.S. the games technically work on mobile, but a large screen is recommended for better experience.
